verdict.rationale: Steel is positioned as an API-first browser product. It publishes a machine-readable OpenAPI spec and documents API endpoints for sessions, CAPTCHAs, credentials, files and agent traces, plus a CLI covering full browser workflows. That gives broad programmatic coverage, but nothing documents parity with the dashboard/UI, so 'everything' is unproven. Missing for 10: explicit UI-to-API parity statement, mapping of dashboard-only features (e.g. trace timeline exports, embed/debug views) to API equivalents, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
